A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
